name: icyboard-ppl
description: Language support for the PCBoard Programming Language

icyboardPpl.serverPath.markdownDescription: Path to the `icyboard-ppl` binary. Leave empty to use the one that ships with the extension, or the one on your PATH.

icyboard-ppl.trace.server.description: Traces the communication between VS Code and the language server.

icyboardPpl.compilerPath.markdownDescription: Path to the `pplc` binary used by *Run PPE*. Leave empty to use the one on your PATH.

icyboardPpl.boardPath.markdownDescription: Path to the `icboard` binary that runs a PPE. Leave empty to use the one on your PATH.

icyboardPpl.boardConfig.markdownDescription: The `icyboard.toml` a PPE is run against, or the directory holding it. Leave empty to let `icboard` look in the workspace folder and in `ICB_PATH`.

icyboardPpl.runArguments.markdownDescription:
What `icboard` is called with. `${ppe}` is the built executable, `${source}` the file it came from and `${workspaceFolder}` the folder it lives in.

To run as a logged-in user, and to pass a PPE its parameters:

`["--runppe", "Sysop;;PWRD:secret;PPE:${ppe};first;second"]`
